about: Formulation and particle / fibre processing: set-temp (per zone / channel), heat, temp, wait-temp, speed, vibration, feed, air, hv, humidity, prime, clean, method, start / stop / result with jobs.

not_here.buchi_minispray: spray dryer: evaporation class; its spray drying is drying, not particle formulation here

acquisition.start:PRECONDITION_FAILED.message: {inst} cannot start: it needs the screws running, a method, material in the hopper, the barrel closed and the cooling water on.
acquisition.start:PRECONDITION_FAILED.fix: check `chemlab run {inst} status`; `chemlab run {inst} speed on` starts the screws.

thermal.set_enabled:PRECONDITION_FAILED.message: {inst} cannot heat: it needs power, the cooling water and the barrel closed.

drive.set_enabled:PRECONDITION_FAILED.message: {inst} cannot start the screws: the barrel must be closed and hot enough for the material, and no emergency stop latched.

unsupported.prime: no priming step (purge by running the screws)
unsupported.clean: the screws are cleaned by hand with the barrel open

set-temp: --zone 1..7 are the barrel zones (feed to die), --zone die the die
wait-temp: without --zone it waits until every zone and the die are at their set points
speed: speed sets the screw speed; `speed on` runs the screws (the run itself uses the method speed)
start: start runs the method: the screws at the method speed, the feeder at the method rate, for the method time

hv.value_fix: the spinning voltage is part of the method: `chemlab run INST method voltage=15kV,15kV ...`; `chemlab run INST hv on|off` switches it.

start.message: {inst} has no spinning method yet.
start.fix: set one: `chemlab run {inst} method voltage=... flows=... rpm=... needle-low=... needle-high=... gap=... time=...`.

start.message: the high voltage of {inst} is off; spinning needs it switched on.
start.fix: switch it on: `chemlab run {inst} hv on`.

method.message: {inst} is running; it takes no new settings now.

acquisition.start:PRECONDITION_FAILED.message: {inst} cannot start: it needs a method, the high voltage on, the door closed, the exhaust on and a collector.

unsupported.speed: the collector speed is the method key rpm
unsupported.feed: the pump flows are the method key flows
unsupported.prime: no priming step (use clean for the needle tips)

method: every setting is needed each time (the instrument does not show the stored ones): voltage (2 groups), flows (8 pumps), rpm, needle-low, needle-high, gap (2 groups each), time
hv: after a run the needles stay charged while hv is on; switch it off before opening the door or cleaning
set-temp: the chamber climate: temperature and humidity are set together; the other stays as it is

feed: feed P sets the feed pressure (gauge) and opens the feed valve; feed off closes the valve and releases the pressure
start: the run ends when the target volume has gone through the nozzle; it does not close the feed: `feed off` afterwards
method: volume = target volume to process, flow = expected flow (the instrument observes the volume; the class accepts this observer-only completion for you)
